Inbox2Action is an autonomous, next-generation Taskmaster Agent operating inside an enterprise command center. Designed for the Taskmaster Track of the All Things Agentic Hackathon, it eliminates administrative friction by ingesting raw, unstructured inbound communications (customer emails, invoice receipts, critical bug reports), extracting actionable parameters, formulating step-by-step resolution plans, and generating ready-to-send responses in seconds.
features: Autonomous Entity Parsing: Leverages gemini-2.5-flash to extract critical task metadata (Priority, Category, Deadlines, Action Items) automatically.
Interactive Enterprise Command Center: A wide-layout UI providing top-level operational metrics, hourly ingestion bars, and real-time radar telemetry traces.
Automated Communications: Crafts precise, professional draft replies formatted in clean Markdown.
Environment Security: Loads API keys dynamically via .env with fallbacks for seamless setup.
Cloud-Ready Containerization: Includes a lightweight Dockerfile configured for Google Cloud Run deployment.
